title: Tour of Monserrat and Sagrada Família
text: Pedro was an amazing guide. We ran into issues with the weather (rain almost everyday) and Pedro was flexible and transparent with us the whole way. He even went as far as to drop us off directly at our next scheduled tour as we were running late. He was incredibly knowledgeable and made the experience very enjoyable. Unfortunately, the mountains were under a thick fog that day which hurt the views but we had a great time and learned so much.
author: I978DUjustins
